label: run141 ST_GAS-committed-fix (PROBE)
definition: (PROBE) Gen-mix merit-order fix on the run139 keeper: restores ST_GAS's committed offer from the run134 cooldown value 0.525 (half every other class) back to cost (~0.91). Diagnosis: ST_GAS ran 97% of hours as a baseload price-taker (over-dispatched +27% / 19 vs measured 15 TWh). The fix works on the MIX — ST_GAS 19->13.7 TWh (+27%->-7%), displaced gen goes to CC_REGULAR/CT (CC_CHP is BTM/steam-following-capped, a separate structural limit). But LMP ticks UP (2024 33.8->34.3, 2025 38.0->38.8, MAE 6.5->7.0): the ST_GAS committed cooldown was an offer markup MASKING the co-opt over-fire by injecting ~4 TWh of artificially-cheap baseload steam. So this un-masks the real 2024/25 over-fire rather than fixing it. The real cause (run142 diagnosis): the CAMPD CF<5% outage rule removes 40-54 GW in shoulder months (Apr/Oct), counting economically-idle coal/CC as unavailable -> false tightness -> co-opt fires VOLL in Oct (17 h>$200 at 73 GW peak) more than real-scarcity Aug (15 h at 85 GW). Not the ORDC curve, reserve credits, or seasonal LOLP (which is flat).
